meta.requirement: Explore Entombed City (1%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: TIP
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: A Meal for Esther
start.text:
''A slumped figure sits against a half-buried pillar, wrapped in a travel cloak gone stiff with frost. Their breath comes thin and white. When they hear you, they lift their head with visible effort.''

Esther: ''hoarse'' Traveller. Please. I have not eaten since yesterday. The cold took my strength before I could make camp properly.

''She tries to stand, then sinks back against the stone, jaw tight.''

Esther: My legs will not take me. There is no food left in my pack. Nothing grows out here. ''swallows'' If there is anything you can hunt nearby... anything...

I_will_find_you_something.text:
Esther: ''nods, eyes already half-closed'' Thank you. I will be here. I cannot go anywhere even if I wanted to.

''She pulls the cloak tighter. Somewhere beyond the ruined arches, something snorts in the drift.''

Esther: Be careful. The Snowboars out here are mean when they are hungry. ''quiet laugh'' Guess that makes two of us.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Hunt nearby for food. Defeat the two Snowboars in Entombed City

continues.label: Do /rpg again and then click on Hunt the Snowboars. Defeat 2 [[Snowboar]]s

Hunt_the_Snowboars.text:
''The second Snowboar goes down hard. Steam rises off the carcasses into the bitter air. You butcher what you can before the cold locks everything solid.''

''Two cuts of Chilled Meat. Dense, freezing, but it is meat.''

''Esther is still waiting by the pillar.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Bring 2 Chilled Meat back to Esther

continues.label: Do /rpg again and then click on Bring Meat to Esther

Bring_Meat_to_Esther.text:
''Esther's eyes open the moment she smells the meat. She reaches for it, then stops, fingers shaking.''

Esther: Chilled Meat. From Snowboars. ''she almost smiles'' You actually found some.

''She turns a cut over in her mittened hands, then shakes her head.''

Esther: I cannot eat it like this. It is frozen through. It would make me sick, and I am already half ice. ''looks up at you'' I cannot walk to a fire. My legs are gone. Please... take it to Springvale. They have cookfires. Make it into something hot. Northern Apple Stew, if you know it. Then bring it back. I will still be here. I have nowhere else to be.

choices.label: I'll cook it in Springvale. (2 Chilled Meat)
I still need to gather the meat

I_still_need_to_gather_the_meat.text:
Esther: ''nods weakly'' Then go. The Snowboars are still out there. I will wait.

''She huddles deeper into the cloak.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Bring 2 Chilled Meat back to Esther

I_ll_cook_it_in_Springvale___2_Chilled_M.text:
Esther: ''presses the meat back into your hands'' Go warm. Springvale's fires are kind. Come back with something I can eat without breaking a tooth.

''She settles against the pillar again, watching the drift as if it might move.''

Esther: And traveller... hurry. The cold does not negotiate.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Cook the Chilled Meat into Northern Apple Stew at Springvale

continues.label: Go to Springvale (Mondstadt), do /rpg and click on Cook the Chilled Meat

Cook_the_Chilled_Meat.text:
''Springvale's cookfires hit you like a wall of kindness after Entombed City. Smoke, fat, and sweet apples hang in the air near the smokehouse.''

''Draff glances over from a hanging rack of game, then at the Chilled Meat in your pack.''

Draff: Dragonspine kill. You can use the side hearth. Apples are in the crate. Do not burn my pots.

choices.label: Cook Northern Apple Stew. (2 Chilled Meat)
I still need the Chilled Meat

I_still_need_the_Chilled_Meat.text:
Draff: ''shrugs'' Hearth is yours when you have the meat. Do not freeze solid on the way back.

''He goes back to his rack.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Cook the Chilled Meat into Northern Apple Stew at Springvale

Cook_the_Chilled_Meat_into_Northern_Appl.text:
''You work the Chilled Meat down over the fire with apple and broth until the ice gives way to steam. The stew thickens, smelling of game and something almost sweet.''

Draff: ''nods once'' That will put life back in someone. Get it north before it cools.

''You seal the pot as best you can. Esther is still waiting in the ruins.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Bring the Northern Apple Stew back to Esther in Entombed City

continues.label: Go to Entombed City (Dragonspine), do /rpg and click on Return to Esther

Return_to_Esther.text:
''The stew's warmth leaks through the wrap as you near Esther's pillar. She is still there, barely upright.''

''Then the snow to your left erupts.''

''Two Snowboars crash out of the drift, snouts high, drawn hard by the smell of cooked meat. Esther shouts a warning that turns into a cough.''

Esther: Behind you!

I_still_need_the_stew.text:
Esther: ''voice thin'' Then cook it. Please. I can smell nothing but cold.

''She closes her eyes again.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Bring the Northern Apple Stew back to Esther in Entombed City

Protect_the_stew__Fight_.text:
''You set the stew behind a stone and draw steel. The Snowboars do not care about Esther's hunger. They only care that something warm and edible is here.''

''Tusks lower. Snow flies.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Defeat the two Snowboars ambushing you near Esther

continues.label: Do /rpg again and then click on Fight the Ambush. Defeat 2 [[Snowboar]]s

____A_Meal_for_Esther__Esther_Fed.title: Esther Fed
____A_Meal_for_Esther__Esther_Fed.text:
''The last Snowboar skids sideways and goes still. Silence rushes back into the ruins.''

''You bring the stew to Esther. She takes it in both hands, breathes the steam, and eats without speaking until color returns to her face.''

Esther: ''quiet, rough'' Alive. That is... thank you. Truly.

''She looks past you, toward a darker mouth of ruined arches where the drift piles higher than a man.''

Esther: Listen. If you keep going that way, be careful. Hunters talk about the Great Snowboar King under Entombed City. Bigger than anything you just fought. Powerful. Mean. ''meets your eyes'' Most who go looking for him do not come back talking about it.

''She wraps the empty pot and settles against the pillar, warmer now.''

Esther: You saved me. Do not throw that away on a rumor. Or if you do... make sure you are ready.
